archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy / Trust) + 4 (Swiss & High Contrast / Modern Editorial)

layout_spacing.cards: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-[#F8FAFC] text-[#0F172A] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-lg font-medium transition-colors duration-200 h-12 px-6 flex items-center justify-center gap-2

login.layout: Two-column split screen. Left side: Form. Right side: Abstract teal texture background

doctor_dashboard.layout: Sidebar + Main Content Header + Grid Layout
doctor_dashboard.stat_cards: Grid cols-1 sm:cols-2 lg:cols-4 gap-6 mb-8. Include subtle icons.
doctor_dashboard.tables: Two tables side-by-side or stacked: 'Today's Appointments' and 'Recent Consultations'.

patients_page.layout: Header with global search and 'Add New Patient' primary button.
patients_page.table_features: Masked Indian phone numbers (e.g., +91 •••• •• 4567), Avatar initials with soft background colors.

add_patient_popup.layout: Modal structure. Two-column grid inside for personal vs medical fields.
add_patient_popup.fields: Name, Age, Gender, Phone, Blood Group, Medical History. Prominent Consent Checkbox before save.

patient_profile.layout: Top Header (Patient Info Card) + Tabs navigation

start_consultation.components: Pre-consultation details -> Vitals inputs -> Prominent Consent Panel -> Recording Controls (large touch targets) -> Live Transcript feed -> AI Generate Buttons

consultation_summary_review.right_column: Doctor Clinical Notes (medical terminology, editable blocks)
consultation_summary_review.actions: Sticky footer or top-right actions for Approval Workflow.

images.description: Abstract teal texture used for the right-hand side of the login screen.
Doctor using a tablet. Useful for empty states or onboarding.
Modern clinic interior, usable as a banner in Clinic Profile settings.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Stroke width 1.5 for a sophisticated look.

testing.requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='add-patient-modal-trigger').

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT USE INTER OR ROBOTO fonts. Use Google Fonts: 'Outfit' for headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text.
Use deeply saturated teal (#0D5C55) for primary accents, not generic bootstrap blue or purple.
Implement mock data using an Indian context: Names like 'Dr. Aisha Sharma', 'Rahul Kumar', and masked numbers like '+91 •••• •• 4567'.
Ensure all buttons and inputs are minimum 44px (h-11 or h-12) to be tablet-friendly.
When building tables, ensure patient rows use the hover states defined. Add status badges with the distinct colors provided.
For the Start Consultation view, the recording controls must be prominent with clear visual feedback (pulse animations) when recording.
The Consultation Summary requires a literal two-column split on desktop (Patient Summary vs Clinical Notes) to allow doctors to review both simultaneously.
Never use fully transparent headers over content; always use the specified glass_panels styles.
Include the required data-testid on all interactive elements as defined in the testing requirements.
